/service-policies.title: Salon Service Policies | Elysia Hair & Nail Salon
/service-policies.description: Review Elysia Hair & Nail Salon’s appointment, pricing, consultation, cancellation, payment, service guarantee, refund and after-hours makeup policies before your visit.
h2: 4. Late Arrivals, Changes and Missed Appointments
p: These policies explain what customers can expect before, during and after receiving services from Elysia Hair & Nail Salon.By confirming an appointment or allowing a service to begin, you acknowledge that you have reviewed and accepted the policies relevant to your service.
Every service begins with a conversation about your goals, current condition, maintenance routine and expected result.Please provide accurate information about:
Products that may affect the requested service

Our team may recommend a different service, additional treatment or a later appointment when the requested result may not be suitable or safely achievable in one visit.Inspiration images are welcome, but they are references rather than guarantees of an identical result.
Website prices are estimates or starting prices.Final pricing may vary based on:
Time required, service complexity and additional work requested during the appointment

Your stylist or service provider will explain the recommended plan and estimated price before beginning.If the service plan needs to change substantially during the appointment, we will discuss the change with you before continuing.

Appointments may be requested by phone, WhatsApp or another contact method offered by the salon.An appointment is not confirmed until the salon accepts the requested date, time and service.Walk-ins are welcome when availability allows, but service cannot be guaranteed without a confirmed appointment.Calling ahead is strongly recommended for:
Event makeup and longer or multi-step services
Please contact us as soon as possible if you need to cancel, reschedule or expect to arrive late.Late arrivals may require us to:
Shorten or modify the requested service

Repeated late cancellations or missed appointments may result in a deposit requirement or limits on future appointment availability.Any applicable cancellation charge or deposit condition will be disclosed before the appointment is confirmed.
Long, high-cost or specially prepared services may require a deposit.When a deposit is required, the salon will explain:
The deposit amount and when it must be paid
Whether it is transferable and the cancellation deadline
When the deposit may be retained

Payment for completed services is due before leaving the salon.We accept the payment methods displayed at the salon. Customers are responsible for confirming prices before approving additional services or add-ons.

Color, perm, straightening, smoothing and extension services may require an in-person consultation, strand test, patch test or service history review.Please disclose previous chemical treatments, box dye, henna, extensions and relevant sensitivities before the service begins.Results may vary based on hair history, condition, porosity, texture and the starting color.Some requested results may require multiple appointments. We will not knowingly continue with a service when our professional assessment indicates an unreasonable risk of significant damage or an unsuitable result.Hair-extension pricing and maintenance requirements are confirmed during consultation.

Children are welcome at Elysia Hair & Nail Salon.A parent or legal guardian must approve services performed on a minor and may be asked to remain present during the appointment.Children who are not receiving a service must remain supervised by a responsible adult.For safety, children should not enter staff-only areas or handle salon tools, products or equipment.The salon may postpone or stop a service if safe completion is not reasonably possible.

Please tell your service provider about allergies, sensitivities, scalp concerns, skin irritation, nail conditions or recent reactions before the service begins.Inform the team immediately if you experience burning, unusual discomfort, dizziness, swelling or another unexpected reaction.We may modify, postpone or decline a service when there is a reasonable health, sanitation or safety concern.Our services are cosmetic and are not a substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment.Regulated services will be assigned only to team members who are legally permitted to perform them in the salon’s location.
We want the finished result to reflect what was agreed during your consultation.If something does not match the agreed service, contact us within the applicable timeframe:
Perm or smoothing concern — within 14 days
Event makeup concern — before the appointment ends

When appropriate, we will arrange a complimentary review and reasonable adjustment related to the original agreed service.The adjustment guarantee does not normally cover a change of mind, a newly requested service, undisclosed treatment history, work performed by another salon, failure to follow aftercare guidance, accidental nail damage or normal wear, damage caused by at-home products or treatments, or differences caused by requesting a different service from the original consultation.Adjustment requests are reviewed individually and do not automatically qualify for a refund.

Completed salon services are generally not refundable simply because a customer changes their mind.When a concern relates to the agreed service, our first step is to review the result and determine whether an appropriate adjustment can be provided under the Service Adjustment Guarantee.Approved refunds, credits or alternative resolutions are determined based on the circumstances, the original consultation and applicable consumer law.This policy does not limit any legal rights that cannot be waived.Retail-product returns, when available, are governed by the product-return policy displayed or communicated at the time of purchase.

Makeup appointments may be available outside regular salon hours for parties and special events. After-hours availability is not guaranteed and must be confirmed directly with the salon.An after-hours appointment may require:
An additional early-hours fee and a specific arrival time

Any additional charge will be disclosed before the appointment is confirmed.Unless otherwise agreed in writing, after-hours makeup is provided at the salon location.Please review the makeup result before the appointment ends and tell the artist immediately if an adjustment is needed.
Customers and team members are expected to communicate respectfully.We may stop or decline a service when a person:
Creates an unsafe environment or sexually harasses staff or customers
Deliberately damages salon property or refuses to follow reasonable safety instructions

Please keep personal belongings with you. Notify the salon promptly if an item is lost or damaged.We will request permission before using identifiable client photos or videos for our website, portfolio, social media or marketing. Declining photography will not affect your access to salon services.

We may update these Service Policies when our services, operating practices or legal obligations change.The version published on the website applies from the date it is posted, except where different terms were expressly agreed for an already-confirmed appointment.Questions about services, pricing or these policies may be directed to:

/.title: Women’s Hair & Nail Salon in Houston, TX | Elysia Hair & Nail Salon
/.description: Visit Elysia Hair & Nail Salon in Houston for women’s haircuts, color, highlights, perms, smoothing, extensions, head spa, nails and event makeup.
h1: A modern hair & nail salon for women and families.
h2: Good to know before your visit
h3: Feedback that speaks to the experience
p: Elysia is located in Houston, Texas, USA.
Every service begins with a conversation about your hair, your routine and the result you want. Prices below are estimates and may vary based on length, density, condition and complexity.
Personalized women’s cuts, kids’ cuts and bang trims designed for your face shape, texture and everyday routine. Every haircut includes a finished style.
Root touch-ups, all-over color, highlights, balayage and dimensional color customized for your current hair and desired result.
Soft waves, body perms and custom curl services designed around your hair length, condition and preferred level of movement.
Straightening, smoothing and frizz-control services selected according to your texture, hair history and maintenance needs.
Customized extensions for additional length, volume or both, with recommendations based on your lifestyle and natural hair.
Moisture, bond-strengthening and deep-conditioning treatments for dry, weakened or chemically processed hair.
A calming shampoo and scalp-care experience with deep cleansing, gentle massage and nourishing hair care to help you relax and refresh.
Manicures, gel polish, nail extensions and simple nail art designed for everyday wear or special occasions.
Personalized makeup for parties, graduations, photos and special celebrations, from natural soft glam to a more polished evening look.
Explore the latest cuts, colors and textures our team has recently created for Elysia clients.
Airy layers with soft movement and face-framing detail.
A rich brunette finish with subtle depth and natural-looking contrast.
Relaxed texture and soft movement designed for easy everyday styling.
Strategic brightness around the face for a fresh, low-maintenance update.
A deep red-brown tone with a polished, reflective finish.
A clean, structured shape softened to suit the client’s features and texture.
Soft beige and honey tones blended for a warm, sunlit finish with a natural grow-out.
A relaxed, polished updo with soft face-framing pieces for parties and special occasions.
Thoughtful service starts with clear communication, honest recommendations and care that continues beyond your visit.
We explain the service, expected maintenance and estimated price before we begin.
Chemical services are planned around your current hair condition, not only the inspiration image.
Every visit begins with a conversation about your goals, comfort level and home routine.
Before you leave, we share personalized advice on washing, styling, products and maintenance to help your result last and keep your hair healthy between visits.
If your result does not match what we agreed, contact us within the timeframe below so our team can review and adjust the service.
Please let us know before the appointment ends

Founded by Maya Tran, Elysia Hair & Nail Salon is a women-focused neighborhood salon serving clients of different ages, hair types and lifestyles. Our team takes time to understand what you want, explain what is realistic and create a result you can comfortably maintain at home.
A local salon built around personal care
Whether you are visiting for a simple trim, a major color change or a special occasion, our goal is to make the process clear, relaxed and personal from the first conversation to the final look.
Dimensional color, balayage and healthy-hair transformations
Precision cuts, textured hair and modern styling
Natural nail care, gel manicures and minimal nail art
Event makeup, soft glam and special occasion beauty
Every client arrives with different hair, routines and expectations. Here are a few examples of the results and experiences created at Elysia.
From flat color to dimensional brunette
Warm dimensional tones were added to create depth while keeping the finished color natural and easy to maintain.
From dry ends to soft healthy movement
Damaged ends were reshaped and supported with a bond-strengthening treatment for a softer, healthier finish.
The stylist explained what would work for my hair before starting, and the final price matched what we discussed.
The salon is clean, welcoming and never feels rushed. I finally found a color I can maintain at home.
I brought my daughter with me and the whole team made both of us feel comfortable.
I came in for a haircut and left with a style that actually fits my routine. The team listened carefully and made the whole visit feel easy and comfortable.
My highlights turned out soft, bright and natural-looking. I really appreciated how clearly everything was explained before we started.
I booked a head spa and it was one of the most relaxing salon visits I’ve had in a long time. My hair felt refreshed and so much healthier afterward.
I came for nails before an event and loved how clean and polished everything looked. The result felt elegant without being overdone.
I needed early event makeup and the team was incredibly accommodating. My makeup looked polished, lasted all day and still felt like me.
A few practical details to help you feel comfortable and prepared before coming to Elysia.
Children are welcome, whether they are receiving a service or visiting with a parent.
The salon includes an accessible entrance and client service area.
Complimentary client parking is available near the salon entrance.
The nearest public transport stop is a short walk from the salon.
Walk-ins are welcome when the team has availability. Calling first is recommended.
Major cards and contactless payment methods are accepted.
Small, well-behaved pets are welcome when accompanied and kept close during your visit.
Our team can assist clients in English and Vietnamese.
Please contact the salon before major color, perm, straightening or extension services.
Hands-on learning in a working salon.
Elysia welcomes beginners who want practical guidance in hair cutting, coloring, styling and everyday salon work.
Observe real services, learn essential techniques and build confidence through guided practice.
Learn how the team prepares tools, consults with clients, maintains a clean workspace and manages everyday salon routines.
Training is kept personal so students can ask questions and receive practical support.
Training availability and cost are discussed individually.
A collection of our space, daily salon moments and the work created for our clients.
A quiet moment at the shampoo station
A busy day with the Elysia team
Here’s how to get here. We can’t wait to welcome you.
We are closed on major holidays. If you plan to visit during a holiday, please contact us first to confirm our hours.
Makeup appointments may be available outside regular salon hours for parties and special events. Please contact us in advance to check availability.
